description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Avatar' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Avatar - the player's iDos Games account avatar in this app (one look per person for every app, edited on idosgames.com; drawn with @idosgames/characters AvatarActor from client.avatar). Enabled (default off: the app uses its own characters and the engine returns no looks), Styles (avatar styles the app draws; empty = every style; known: voxel-v1), BlockedSlots (slots never shown, their items taken off: hair, top, bottom, shoes, hands, waist, back, faceAcc, hat), HeightMin and HeightMax (0.9..1.1 on the standard's scale, 1 = standard; players outside are clamped).

value.description: The player's iDos Games account avatar in this app: one look per person for every app, edited on idosgames.com. The app decides here what of it to show; the engine returns the look already trimmed by these rules. Without the section, or with Enabled not true, the app uses its own characters and the engine returns no looks.

BlockedSlots.description: Slots the app never shows (their items are taken off): hair, top, bottom, shoes, hands, waist, back, faceAcc, hat.

Enabled.description: Use the account avatar in this app (default off).

HeightMax.description: Highest height the app allows, on the standard's scale (0.9..1.1, 1 = standard).

HeightMin.description: Lowest height the app allows, on the standard's scale (0.9..1.1, 1 = standard). Taller or shorter players are clamped.

Styles.description: Avatar styles the app can draw; empty = every style of the standard. Known now: voxel-v1 (the voxel chibi of @idosgames/characters).
